purpose: Disposition the missing referenced provenance artifacts for the imported Ayodhya Kanda Sarga 21 and Sarga 22 staging records using currently accessible GitHub evidence, without inventing or reconstructing unavailable source-registry/checkpoint state.

recovery_checks.qualification: The current canonical Git tree contains the imported project-state metadata and Sarga 21/22 staging payloads, but the named stable-ID registries and checked later ledger output are not present.
This establishes no recoverable root-path history for the checked names; it does not prove that similarly named files never existed outside GitHub or under an inaccessible workspace path.

findings: The real post-v1 Sarga 21 and Sarga 22 staging payloads remain available in the canonical HI-TECH repository and were already classified as partial evidence.

RAMAVERSE_PROJECT_STATE.json references stable-ID registries and later ledger outputs that would be relevant to proving the provenance transition, but the checked referenced artifacts are not recoverable from the currently accessible GitHub trees/history.
The imported workspace metadata claim missing_files=[] cannot be treated as a GitHub checkpoint guarantee because the referenced artifacts are not present in the imported canonical Git tree.
The sourceVersion claim 56bb0d6+working-tree-2026-08-25 is workspace provenance metadata, not a currently resolvable commit in the accessible ssakthivel02/ramaverse repository.
No recovered evidence binds the imported Sarga 21/22 payloads to the verified 28-record physical checkpoint source registry or to an immutable replacement checkpoint.
Therefore the missing provenance is dispositioned as unrecovered across currently accessible GitHub sources, not as proven never to have existed.
reopen_conditions: A genuine copy of one or more referenced source registries, master ledgers, physical audit files, source ledgers or immutable checkpoint artifacts is supplied from the original workspace/export.

The supplied artifact has independently verifiable provenance and can be correlated to the exact Sarga 21/22 staging payloads using source IDs, candidate IDs, hashes, timestamps or equivalent immutable evidence.
Any recovered source URLs, rights states, review states and ledger transitions can be independently validated before a new versioned checkpoint is proposed.
safety_boundary: Do not recreate missing ledgers from narrative metadata and present them as historical originals.
Do not synthesize source-registry rows merely because the Sarga 21/22 payloads contain source IDs.
Do not overwrite or amend the historical 28-record checkpoint.
Do not acquire Sarga 23 based on this disposition.
Do not publish Sarga 21/22 staging payloads through Reader, Search, Ask, offline canonical corpus or production APIs.
Do not modify legacy/reference repositories during provenance recovery.
